# Evidence card — Too much right now

This skill is ordinary demand reduction, not therapy. Emotion-regulation evidence concerns clinician-delivered CBT and group averages.

Use only these claims, within the scope stated. None of them tested this software.

- **CLM-RS-EMOTION-DYSREG** (checked against an abstract or summary only): A 2020 meta-analysis (Beheshti et al., BMC Psychiatry; 13 studies, N = 2,535) found emotion dysregulation was markedly elevated on average in adults with ADHD compared with controls (g = 1.17), and correlated with ADHD symptom severity (r = 0.54). This is a group average, not a diagnosis of any user, and not evidence for this software.
  Source: [Emotion dysregulation in adults with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder: a meta-analysis](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12888-020-2442-7).
- **CLM-GD-AADPA-CBT** (checked against an abstract or summary only): The Australian guideline text indicates cognitive-behavioural interventions should be offered to adults with ADHD as an option to consider, ideally ADHD-specific and strengths-based.
  Source: [Australian Evidence-Based Clinical Practice Guideline for ADHD: Cognitive-behavioural interventions (section 4.2.2)](https://adhdguideline.aadpa.com.au/non-pharmacological/cognitive-behavioural-interventions/cognitive-behaviour-interventions/).

Full register, statuses and limitations: `evidence/claims.yaml` in the source repository. Runtime snapshot: `references/shared/runtime-evidence.md`. No claim has been reviewed by a clinician.
